INPUT_UNCLEAR: Supply the ambition, explicit consent, a finite candidate model family, every allowed experiment and production recipe, exact response/yield predictions, acceptance target and USD cost budget. Missing predictions are unknowns, not zeros. This edition does not infer a real plant model from prose.
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The implemented route is deterministic local Python. No local LLM runtime or external provider adapter is included. Use the supplied finite tables or stop. No automatic cloud fallback, data transfer, keys or spending occurs.
INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES: Use Python 3.12 and the documented finite input limits. The 32 MiB preflight is a declared minimum envelope; actual memory, hardware, electricity and latency are not guaranteed. Reduce the supplied finite problem or stop. Resource exhaustion is not mathematical infeasibility.
NO_QUALIFIED_POLICY: No policy in this declared finite experiment/recipe family meets the stated target and budget. Inspect the conventional comparison. An additional justified observation, different recipe, larger authorized budget or withdrawal may change the decision. Do not quietly relax acceptance.
MODEL_MISMATCH: An observation is inconsistent with every admitted mechanism. Stop this workflow and retain the observation. Obtain a justified replacement model/measurement contract before creating a distinct request. Do not discard the failed result.
PRODUCTION_REJECTED: The actual supplied output did not meet the independent yield target even though the declared model could predict success. A mechanism outside the model family can match all chosen observations. Reject delivery and revise the domain/acceptance contract; reasoning alone cannot rule out an unobserved distinction.
SOURCE_CHANGED: Resume with the original source files and session. A source or request change is not an automatic migration and does not inherit acceptance. Never delete an original account or session to suppress its history.
BUYER_DECLINED: No more probes or production are allowed in this session. Declining is a valid result. Already incurred simulated work stays in the receipt; declining does not erase it. No sale or buyer benefit is inferred.
EXTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION: Future external model processing requires explicit permission for the precise data, provider account and spending limit. This edition has no implemented external-model adapter and makes no provider calls even when permission is supplied. Third-party compute, taxes, hardware and energy are separate buyer costs.
